<!-- GENERATED by scripts/docs/keyboard-shortcuts.mjs from the editor's default keymap: do not edit by hand. -->

Shortcuts use `Ctrl` on Windows and Linux and `Cmd` on a Mac. Press `?` in the editor for the same list,
where each shortcut can be changed; changes are kept in your settings.

## Editing

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Undo | `Ctrl+Z` |
| Redo | `Ctrl+Shift+Z`, `Ctrl+Y`, `Ctrl+Shift+Y` |
| Zoom in | `Ctrl+=`, `Ctrl++` |
| Zoom out | `Ctrl+-` |
| Zoom to 100 % | `Ctrl+0`, `Ctrl+Shift+0`, `Shift+0` |
| Zoom to fit the screen | `Shift+1` |
| Zoom to the selection | `Shift+2` |
| Cancel | `Esc` |
| Nudge left 1 px | `Left` |
| Nudge left 10 px | `Shift+Left` |
| Nudge right 1 px | `Right` |
| Nudge right 10 px | `Shift+Right` |
| Nudge up 1 px | `Up` |
| Nudge up 10 px | `Shift+Up` |
| Nudge down 1 px | `Down` |
| Nudge down 10 px | `Shift+Down` |
| Select all | `Ctrl+A`, `Ctrl+Shift+A` |
| Copy | `Ctrl+C` |
| Cut | `Ctrl+X` |
| Paste | `Ctrl+V` |
| Duplicate | `Ctrl+D` |
| Group | `Ctrl+G` |
| Ungroup | `Ctrl+Shift+G` |
| Edit the text | `Enter`, `F2` |
| Delete the selection | `Delete`, `Backspace` |
| Keyboard shortcuts | `?` |
| Command palette | `Ctrl+K` |

## Tools

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Connector tool | `C` |
| Frame tool | `F` |
| Freehand tool | `D` |
| Hand tool | `H` |
| Image tool | `I` |
| Laser tool | `L` |
| Pen tool | `P` |
| Select tool | `V` |
| Shape tool | `R` |
| Text tool | `T` |

## Presenting

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Present from the first visible screen | `F5` |
| Present the shown screen / stop presenting | `Shift+F5`, `Esc` |
